caption: The drawing features three views of an ornamental rectangular buckle on a beige background. The topmost object is a detailed, shaded depiction of the buckle, which is rectangular, featuring a complex design composed of small circular and oval elements arranged in symmetrical patterns around the frame. The center of the buckle contains vertical and horizontal metal bars. Below this, to the left, is a simplified outline of the buckle, showing its overall shape and internal structure without detailed ornamentation. To the right of the outline view, there is a thin side profile of the buckle, represented as a simple line drawing that illustrates its thickness and slight curvature. The entire composition is rendered in grayscale pencil or ink on a lightly textured beige paper. In the lower left corner, the names "WALTON, KALANIAN" are inscribed in small block letters.
title: Lady's Shoe Buckle
